concerns.text: The plan validates niche‑stability (i.e., ‘historic models will show a measurable decline in predictive performance when projected onto future climate’) by computing `delta_suitability = mean(suitability_2050) – mean(suitability_2005‑2020)` and testing it with a hierarchical bootstrap. Both the outcome (delta suitability) and the predictor (model‑generated suitability scores) are derived from the same SDM trained on historical data, with no independent observational data for the future period. This makes the validation circular: the metric used to claim a niche shift is a deterministic function of the model’s own predictions, not an external ground‑truth, so the analysis can only ever confirm the model’s internal response to altered climate, not actual ecological change. The claim therefore lacks an independent validation target and is true by construction rather than empirically demonstrated.
